title: The l-adic Weil representation category and its actual-tensor compatibility predicate
statement: Fix a prime $l$, an algebraic closure $Q$ of $\mathbf Q_l$, a Noetherian separated scheme $Y$ on which $l$ is invertible, a geometric point $t$, and an automorphism $h:Y\simeq Y$. Use the actual etale lisse algebraic coefficient category and $h^*$ of [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves, def-wf-lisse-adic-automorphism-pullback]. Let $G$ be a group with degree datum $d$, and let $D$ identify the geometric fundamental group at $t$ with $\ker d$ and supply the normalized path to $h(t)$ as in [def-wf-fundamental-representation, sk-d-real-weil]. Write $\mathcal W$ for invertible $h^*$-algebras. Let $\mathcal R$ be the full subcategory of $\operatorname{Rep}_Q(G)$ whose restriction along $D$ is l-adic in the finite coefficient-field sense of [def-pod-l-adic-representations]. For an equivalence $e:\mathcal W\simeq\mathcal R$, its actual-tensor compatibility is the existence of monoidal structures on the underlying lisse category, $\mathcal W$ and $\mathcal R$, with the underlying lisse tensor objects and unit precisely the recorded algebraic tensor and unit, such that the forgetful functor, inclusion into representations and $e$ are strong monoidal. No connectedness is required for these definitions.

proof.text: Use the full subcategory of Rep on representations whose geometric restriction is l-adic. Record monoidal structures with the stated tensor objects and unit, and monoidal forgetful, inclusion, and realization functors. These are the original two definitions, moved verbatim.
